variables.name: MQTT_HOST
variables.description: The IPv4 address of Home Assistant's MQTT broker (the Mosquitto add-on runs on the Home Assistant machine). The bridge connects to it on port 1883.

variables.name: MQTT_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password of the bridge's user on the MQTT broker. Create the user in Home Assistant (Settings, People, Users) or in the Mosquitto add-on.

variables.name: MQTT_USERNAME
variables.description: The bridge's user on the MQTT broker. Unset: homelab.
